probe_detail.name: A specific concrete detail carries the joke
Trailing furniture: hashtags, handles, parenthetical byline
Sets up an expectation and then turns it
Extent of capitalised or shouted typography

final.name: Specific situation brought into view, typography disregarded
final.audit_justification: Rewards a sharply particularized scene/actor/action in the joke content itself, independent of typography, which is a genuine craft measure.

final.name: Count of handles, hashtags, and repeated topic tokens
final.audit_justification: Pure count of tag/handle/keyword furniture explicitly divorced from whether the tagging is apt, funny, or good; keyword-stuffing behavior has no plausible link to genuinely better writing.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Concrete topical mechanism

final.name: Extent of uppercase and emphatic typography
final.audit_justification: Pure estimate of capitalization/emphatic-punctuation share, explicitly not judging whether the emphasis is earned or suits the joke; a typing-style habit, not a skill marker.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Phonetic snap

final.name: List/enumeration structure with a pattern-breaking final item
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether a comic list structure culminates in an effective pattern-breaking twist, a genuine joke-construction feature.

final.name: Self-contained delivery
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the complete comic premise and payoff are present in the text alone, a genuine completeness-of-craft measure.

final.name: Doubled/extra whitespace between words, tag, or handle
final.audit_justification: Flags mere doubled-space typographic artifacts with explicit indifference to readability; a copy-paste/typing artifact with no link to joke quality.

final.name: Rhythm and sound pattern when said aloud, plain text
final.audit_justification: Explicitly strips tags and typography and judges only the craft of the line's spoken rhythm, cadence, and sound.

final.name: Topic tied to a named behavior, contradiction, or institution
final.audit_justification: Checks whether the joke's mechanism is a concrete behavior, contradiction, or institution rather than bare topic-naming, i.e. genuine engagement with the content.

final.name: Ironic Premise Reversal
final.audit_justification: Scores whether the wording enacts a literal self-reversal exposing a comic contradiction, a core joke technique.

final.name: Lands on first read without puzzle-decoding
final.audit_justification: Measures how quickly the payoff resolves for the reader, an intrinsic craft/design property of how the joke is built.

final.name: Constraint-Native Phrasing
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether the wording exploits the format constraint as a natural complete phrase rather than reading as padded or truncated, a craft judgment.

final.name: Punchline Closure
final.audit_justification: Scores whether the ending delivers a decisive comic payoff versus stopping at setup, core punchline craft.

final.name: Bare shortened link indicating an unseen attached image
final.audit_justification: Flags presence of a bare shortened URL pointing at unseen content, explicitly not inferring whether the missing payload is funny; a platform/production artifact.
final.upstream_parent: an attached image or media object that carries part or all of the entry and is invisible to any text-only reader

final.name: External-artifact residue
final.audit_justification: Counts presence of URLs, attachment cues, or platform artifacts, explicitly never judging whether they improve the entry.

final.name: Contest hashtag casing fidelity to the canonical form
final.audit_justification: Compares tag casing to the canonical form as a pure fidelity/convention-following check, not a quality judgment, though matching the canonical form plausibly also marks a practiced entrant familiar with the contest who writes better jokes too.
final.upstream_parent: the author's practice in this nightly format: whether the tag was autocompleted or copied from the show's own post versus retyped from memory

final.name: Unexpected Semantic Collision
final.audit_justification: Scores whether two unlike concepts collide into an immediately intelligible joke, a core comic-technique measure.

final.name: Tweet opens with the @midnight mention as first token
final.audit_justification: Purely checks whether '@midnight' literally opens the text, an extent/positional-formatting measure explicitly not a quality judgment, and more likely a submission-mechanic (reply-thread) artifact than a skill marker.
final.upstream_parent: author's submission/reply convention (a leading @-mention reads as a Twitter reply, which by default limits the tweet's visibility to mutual followers rather than a full broadcast) or general practice/habit in this format

final.name: Concrete Visualizability
final.audit_justification: Scores whether the tweet evokes a vivid, instantly picturable scene, a content/craft property.

final.name: Off-contest metadata load: promo tags, self-reference, show flattery
final.audit_justification: Counts off-prompt material such as promo tags, self-branding, and show flattery, explicitly not judging whether such self-promotion is tacky; this padding is more plausibly a distraction than a marker of better writing.
final.upstream_parent: the author's engagement-farming practice: growing reach or courting the show's attention alongside entering the contest

final.name: Title transformation
final.audit_justification: Judges whether a recognizable title is reworked into a fresh, coherent comic premise, a transformation-craft measure.

final.name: Transformation depth beyond a one-token swap
final.audit_justification: Scores how much original idea a mashup/pun substitution adds beyond bare source-recognition, genuine craft depth.

final.name: Raw word count of the joke content
final.audit_justification: Maps raw word count to a 0-10 extent scale, explicitly not judging whether the length is effective, though more words can also reflect a more fully realized setup-and-payoff that is genuinely better crafted.

final.name: Extent of textual bulk and tag furniture
final.audit_justification: Estimates overall character length plus tag/handle count as a bulk/furniture extent that by its own description scores a bloated item and a well-used long item identically, so the same bulk can stem from either nuisance padding or genuinely fuller craft.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Vivid Scene Specificity

final.name: Memorable Cadence
final.audit_justification: Scores whether rhythm, repetition, or sound make the line punchy when read aloud, a comic-delivery craft measure.

final.name: Borrowed stock phrase bent, not merely quoted
final.audit_justification: Scores how much a borrowed stock phrase is recontextualized versus quoted verbatim, a transformation-craft measure.
